purpose: Measure local pairwise, parallel-copy, remote-write, and all-to-all transfer ceilings
capability_probe: verify all eight leased GPUs are visible in the intended physical order
run the built-in p2p health/smoke preset before ceiling sweeps
preconditions: run under the same eight-GPU visibility and topology as MegaMoE
sweep message sizes spanning MegaMoE payload and metadata regimes
record executor/engine mode instead of combining GFX and DMA results
repeat until variance is reported and retain per-link/pair results
do not substitute the best pairwise result for an all-to-all ceiling

outputs.artifact: raw preset output per message size and engine
outputs.information: transfer time and bandwidth for pairwise/pcopy/rwrite/a2a patterns
git revision, build flags, commands, topology, repetitions and raw paths

provenance.notes: Preset CLI details are version-dependent; save the TransferBench git revision and --help output with each run.
